applies_to: Daikin MicroTech III Generic I/O Panel used in the Daikin Delivered VAV System (software 2508022100 and later).
summary: A general-purpose MicroTech III controller with fixed I/O used in Daikin's Delivered VAV System. Over BACnet MS/TP it exposes its six analog inputs, five universal analog outputs, six digital inputs and ten digital outputs as objects, plus five PID loops (one per analog output) with setpoint, tuning and input selection. There is no equipment logic beyond that, so what each point means depends on the job wiring.
notes: Object names come from the full references in the guide's detail pages (e.g. <Device Name>.DO1).
Inputs, analog values and multistate values are marked W1 in the guide: writable only while Out_Of_Service is true. They are shown here as W. Outputs (AO, BO) are commandable.
The detail page for AO 1 (Analog Output X1) prints the reference name AI1, the same as AI 1; X1 would be expected. It is listed as printed.
AI 4-6 are universal inputs X6-X8; AO 1-5 are universal outputs X1-X5.
Units of the PID setpoints and readings follow the sensors wired to the panel; MV 1 switches metric/English.
Not BTL listed; the PICS is ED 19013.

source.title: MicroTech III Generic I/O Panel Protocol Information, BACnet Networks

integration.summary: The panel ships pre-configured for the Delivered VAV System, so normally the BMS only reads its I/O. Outputs (AO, BO) are commandable. Inputs, PID settings (AV) and the PID input and units selectors (MSV) are writable only while Out_Of_Service is true.
integration.remote_sensors: Inputs (AI, BI) can be written only after setting Out_Of_Service true.
setup: Defaults: MS/TP MAC 120, 38400 baud, device instance 3101120, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1.
The device object name is POL904_ followed by a code computed from the production number and date code.
MAC address is set at the keypad; cycle power after changing it. Daikin advises not to change communication settings unless told to by the factory.
gotchas: Point meaning depends on the job wiring; check the submittal for what each input and output is connected to.
